fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: The Sharīʿah is justice and mercy
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn al-Qayyim** said:

> ***“Ibn al-Qayyim said in substance: The Sharīʿah is entirely justice, mercy, wisdom, and benefit.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever understands Allah’s law correctly recognizes in it not arbitrariness, but perfect justice, mercy, and wisdom.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Qayyim, Iʿlām al-Muwaqqiʿīn, Abschnitt über die Grundlagen der Sharīʿah.
